title: NVIDIA Releases Open Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Training Large Language Models
description: NVIDIA today announced Nemotron-4 340B, a family of open models that developers can use to generate synthetic data for training large language models (LLMs) for commercial applications across healthcare, finance, manufacturing, retail and every other industry. title: ‘The Proudest Refugee’: How Veronica Miller Charts Her Own Path at NVIDIA
